rationale: A hard Microsoft vendor deadline (February 1, 2027) forces non-optional spend on MFA migration across every M365 tenant globally. Active forum threads on ServerFault, Reddit r/sysadmin, and Microsoft Tech Community show IT admins hitting real edge-case blockers daily — conditional access policy conflicts, legacy device exclusions, on-prem hybrid joins — with no consolidated guidance. Competitors charge $50–$500 for adjacent compliance readiness tooling, confirming willingness to pay.
